row.summary_zh: 10 月 20 日版本新增 GEMM/MultiHeadAttention 的 INT4/INT6/INT8 块量化、导出工具和多 CPU 后端实现。发布说明明确区分权重量化与动态激活量化。
row.summary_en: The October 20 release adds block-quantized INT4/INT6/INT8 GEMM and MultiHeadAttention, export tools and multiple CPU implementations, explicitly separating weight-only and dynamic-activation paths.
row.dependencies_zh: 块大小为 32/64/128；INT8 CPU 路径采用动态逐行/逐块激活量化、INT32 点积及逐块反量化累加。具体 ISA 与 storage 路径按后端核对。
row.dependencies_en: Block sizes are 32/64/128. The INT8 CPU path uses dynamic per-row/per-block activation quantization, INT32 dot products and per-block dequantized accumulation. ISA and storage paths vary by backend.
row.boundary_zh: INT4/INT6 为权重量化；MHA 仅量化 Q/K/V/out projection，Attention 与 KV cache 保持浮点。新 KV 布局当前 batch=1，升级不能复用旧手工/持久化 cache。版本说明未给统一质量或端到端加速比。
row.boundary_en: INT4/INT6 are weight-only. MHA quantizes Q/K/V/out projections while attention and KV caches remain floating-point. The new KV layout supports batch=1 and is incompatible with old manually constructed/persisted caches. No common quality or end-to-end speedup benchmark is supplied.
row.scope_zh: 补充端侧 CPU 低比特执行和导出边界，不把投影量化写成完整 Attention 量化。
row.scope_en: Adds edge-CPU low-bit execution and export constraints without conflating projection and complete attention quantization.

row.boundary_en: This is an official engineering article about recurrent-state execution, not a new architecture release or KV-cache quantization. The FP32-state timing runs and separate low-precision-read quality experiments are distinct configurations. No local reproduction or Ascend validation is available.
row.boundary_zh: 这是循环状态执行的官方技术文章，不是本月新架构发布或KV量化。FP32状态计时与低精读取质量实验是不同配置，不能拼接收益；尚无本地复现或昇腾验证。
row.date_locator: Article byline: Oct 12, 2026; ReplaySSM: Rethinking State Storage for Faster Hybrid-Model Decoding
row.dependencies_en: vLLM implementation versus tuned vLLM kernels; FP32 SSM state, L=16. Nemotron-3-Nano-4B and Qwen3.5-4B use BF16 weights on one H100 each; Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B use NVFP4 weights on one B300 each. Table 1 uses no tensor parallelism.
row.dependencies_zh: vLLM实现对照其调优内核，SSM状态为FP32、窗口L=16。Nemotron-3-Nano-4B与Qwen3.5-4B分别以BF16权重运行于单H100；Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B与Qwen3.5-122B-A10B分别以NVFP4权重运行于单B300，Table 1均未用张量并行。
row.scope_en: October publication on checkpoint-plus-input-buffer execution for existing Attention/SSM hybrid models; use it as a recurrent-state deployment observation.
row.scope_zh: 10月公开的既有Attention／SSM混合模型检查点与输入缓冲执行观察，归入循环状态部署进展。
row.summary_en: ReplaySSM separates per-token output reads from less frequent checkpoint writes. FP32-state runs report 1.20–1.47× decode-step speedup at batch 256 across four models, with no speedup at batch 1.
row.summary_zh: ReplaySSM将逐token输出读取与低频检查点写回分离。四模型FP32状态测试在batch=256报告decode step加速1.20–1.47倍，batch=1无收益。

row.boundary_en: The host WER evaluation and single-phone timing are different experiments. The 1.61× result enables SME2 within QC8W; it does not compare INT8 with FP16. Whole-recording processing time excludes waiting for live audio collection. No local reproduction, Ascend support, or satisfaction of the user's quality target is established.
row.boundary_zh: host端WER与单手机计时为不同实验。1.61倍是同QC8W启用SME2的收益，并非INT8比FP16；整段处理耗时不包含实时收音等待。未本地复现、未证实昇腾支持，也不据此判定满足用户质量目标。
row.date_locator: Article byline: October 26, 2026; Optimizing Streaming Speech Recognition on Arm® Edge Devices with ExecuTorch
row.dependencies_en: Nemotron 3.5 RNN-T; ExecuTorch 1.3.1, XNNPACK and KleidiAI. Device timing uses one Pixel 11, one inference thread pinned to a mid-core CPU, 1,120 ms chunks and a 24.9 s recording; two warm-ups precede one measured tracing run. SME2-on and off builds use identical artifacts.
row.dependencies_zh: Nemotron 3.5 RNN-T，ExecuTorch 1.3.1、XNNPACK与KleidiAI。设备计时使用单Pixel 11、固定中核的一条推理线程、1,120毫秒音频块与24.9秒录音；两次预热后仅一次计时跟踪。SME2开关构建使用相同模型产物。
row.scope_en: October deployment case study linking streaming-ASR precision, chunk cadence and executed Arm kernels; this is not an October algorithm release.
row.scope_zh: 10月公开的流式ASR部署案例，联合核对精度、切块节奏和实际Arm内核，不作为本月新算法发布。
row.summary_en: QC8W uses dynamic INT8 activations and per-channel INT8 weights for eligible linear operations. Host WER rises by 0.21–0.31 percentage points versus FP32; enabling SME2 lowers the QC8W whole-recording processing time from 5.20 to 3.24 s. SME2-enabled FP16 takes 4.61 s.
row.summary_zh: QC8W对适用线性运算采用动态INT8激活和逐通道INT8权重。host端WER较FP32增加0.21–0.31个百分点；同QC8W启用SME2后整段录音处理由5.20降至3.24秒，已启SME2的FP16为4.61秒。
